"""FIXTURE (not real code): a handler that bypasses the repository layer on purpose.

Stored as .txt so ruff, mypy and pytest never treat it as part of the codebase.
The guard must flag every marked line.
"""

import uuid

from fastapi import APIRouter
from sqlalchemy import select  # VIOLATION database-import
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session  # VIOLATION database-import

from app.data.models import Project  # VIOLATION orm-models-import

router = APIRouter()


@router.get("/api/leaky/{project_id}")
def leaky(project_id: uuid.UUID, session: Session) -> dict[str, str]:
    row = session.execute(select(Project).where(Project.id == project_id)).scalar_one()  # VIOLATION sql-execution
    return {"name": row.name}
